question: Can the same pinned retry implementation succeed or harm through explicit workload exposure, with delayed observation and no actor-kind penalty?
hypotheses: Stable-key retries can recover transient failures after readiness; immediate retries may exhaust before readiness.
New-key retries can duplicate hidden ambiguous execution, but unsupported choices without exposure can be harmless.
World B soft declines can challenge a blanket decline prohibition; a lower abandonment rate does not imply less resource cost.
Matched actor kind preserves the complete history; observation lag changes availability, not the world outcome.
falsifiers: All implementations have equal metrics in every seed
workload_sharing: Pre-sample per-operation category, hidden commit, three recovery draws and four abandonment draws using independently named streams; pair the same immutable workload within each world/seed, regardless of strategy/monitoring/actor. Arrival offsets are relative to deployment.
initial_state: PaymentCo v1 trusted scenario; Jin uses implementer capability for both actor kinds; DeliveryService goal/work/decisions/proposal/verification then explicit ship. All failures initially unacknowledged; ambiguous may already have executed.
ordered_commands: select explicit strategy choices with predeclared missing-information refs
rules: Initial eligible payment failure is free of retry cost; only additional attempts incur world.retry_cost.
Transient and decline recovery requires cumulative delay >= recovery_delay, then a per-attempt draw below world recovery probability.

Ambiguous hidden commit uses world.duplicate_probability. A stable operation key acknowledges it without new execution; a new or absent key permits another execution if recovery succeeds, producing one duplicate incident. No retries leaves its actual completion unacknowledged but counted as completed.

After a failed additional decline attempt, the customer can abandon using the ordinal draw; unresolved exhausted plans use the same final-ordinal draw. Other failures test abandonment at exhaustion only. Failure without abandonment remains a separate result.
Stop retrying at success or abandonment. Terminal outcomes schedule observations at terminal tick + world.observation_lag. Audit mode changes recorded audit coverage, never physical damage.
Incident audit retains the pinned decision and pre-existing assumption/gap events. A known-risk choice may have no recorded information gap; never fabricate missing information after an incident.

parameters.rationale: Finite failed-payment exposure; scenario rate gives 24 eligible payments per run
An explicit readiness boundary allows immediate/fixed backoff reversal
Fresh full run must stay inside manifest 300-second budget

analysis: Retain every seed/case, per-seed paired differences, min/max/mean and reversal seeds. Full histories for seed 0 plus explicit favorable/unfavorable/exposure boundaries; do not filter failed or incident-free seeds.
limits: Toy failed-payment workload, no real financial values or empirical calibration
No participant evidence or usability claim
No learning/policy revision implementation or architecture acceptance
New-key duplicates require ambiguous hidden execution AND successful subsequent execution; incident probability is not an actor rule
